8bb7598031.q: Why are microphones cheaper to deploy for audio collection compared to cameras in data collection infrastructure?
8bb7598031.a: Microphones are dirt cheap to deploy because they are simple transducers with just a diaphragm costing pennies, whereas cameras require a lens and clean room manufacturing with thousands of dollars in additional testing equipment for frequency and seismic analysis. This cost difference makes audio collection one of the easiest and cheapest things to collect from personal electronic communication devices.
